name: Lynn Sullivan
reason: Health restore, re-checked 12 Nov 2026: still out (judgement call). Her site (lynnasullivan.com, Cincinnati, Ohio; robots.txt allows us) presents her practice as focused on people going through cancer treatment and people in physical pain: the menu is led by Cancer Support, a Wholistic Cancer Support Summit and cancer support packages (chemotherapy, radiation, surgery and side-effect meditation bundles with eight healing sessions), and her neuropathy meditation is sold as designed to 'calm neuropathy pain to leave your body' (a claim about a medical condition). The pain-relief meditation, chakra and fear meditations and Brennan-style energy-healing sessions would pass on their own, but they sit inside a cancer-and-pain-led practice, and the rest of the site is Young Living oil sales, a fragrance course and home-design pages. Contact exists (energywithlynn@aol.com). Owner may prefer to list her with the cancer, neuropathy and side-effect items left out.
